description: Happy path, DEPRECATED SPELLING: EHR-imported coverage typed clinical:CoverageRecord, retained for legacy read

input.payorName: Blue Cross Blue Shield of Oregon

notes: DELIBERATELY RETAINED LEGACY-READ FIXTURE. NOT the recommended spelling for new data -- coverage:InsurancePlan is, and coverage-001 is the worked example of it. clinical:CoverageRecord has been deprecated since clinical v1.5 and is RETAINED rather than removed, because real pre-migration Pods still hold records in this spelling and they must stay readable and checkable. spec's CONTRIBUTING.md, 'Deprecating a spelling', requires a retained spelling to keep a fixture demonstrating it still reads, so that retirement is a decision rather than an accident; this is that fixture. Recovered from this repository's own history rather than invented: the triples are the pre-migration form of coverage-001 at 0a7d5dc^, carried forward under a distinct subject IRI so the two fixtures are not mistaken for one record. Exercises both departures clinical:CoverageRecordShape documents against coverage:InsurancePlanShape -- the FIRST, clinical:relationship bound to this vocabulary's five values ('self' here) rather than the seven-code HL7 SubscriberPolicyholder set; and the SECOND, clinical:effectivePeriodStart accepting the xsd:dateTime midnight-UTC placeholder the importer emitted alongside the declared xsd:date range. clinical:payorName is carried too, but the shape header at clinical.shapes.ttl:2472 is explicit that it is an EXTRA property this spelling has and coverage: never named distinctly, NOT a departure. The value of clinical:coverageType is judged separately and advisorily by clinical:CoverageTypeVocabularyShape at sh:Warning; 'primary' is in that set by name, and the rejection path is exercised by clinical/coverage-record-legacy-type-vocabulary.WARN.ttl.
